subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, refresh one of the conflicting fork PR candidates, or wait for contributor updates?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the current no-new-fix-pr state plus conflicting linked fork candidates means another automatic branch could add duplicate churn unless a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed and fork PRs only as source context.

options.title: Refresh one fork PR
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same focused coverage and real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch into a mergeable, proven state.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed and fork PRs only as source context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path ownership makes this the strongest current routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
